title: Chrome AI Can Shop For You in India? Free vs Paid Gemini Auto Browse
description:
Google brought Gemini in Chrome to Android users in India and expanded auto browse for eligible Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers. But what is FREE, what requires a subscription, and what should you check before letting an AI browser perform a task?

In this video: 00:00 Your AI browser and a hypothetical grocery task; 00:21 Free Gemini in Chrome vs paid auto browse; 00:38 Summarize a web page; 00:49 Auto browse and eligibility; 01:12 Example shopping workflow; 01:35 Why plan review matters; 02:13 Three safety checks; 02:36 Device and rollout requirements; 03:03 Which task would you trust?

This is an ILLUSTRATIVE explainer with fictional prices and interface reconstructions. It is not a live Google Chrome demo, actual transaction or security evaluation. Google warns that AI agents can make mistakes and may share information with websites as instructed; sensitive actions should be reviewed. Rollout, language, plan, and eligibility vary.
